cases: a radical mandate multiplies a labor site's industrial output by camp_admin_labor.radical_output without changing who is assigned
radical labor deaths equal the coercive deaths times camp_admin_labor.radical_mortality (within whole-person rounding); custody deaths are the same under both mandates
supply strain leaves the workforce intact; acute shortage, famine and catastrophic famine scale it by their constants
the legacy labor burden index follows assigned labor: unchanged for a working site, zero when suspended or under a custody mandate
limits: Parsed production helpers with harness primitives; no HOI4 execution and no live Famine registry.
